blocks.text: Condo buildings in Hyde Park South Surrey

Hyde Park is one townhome community by Zenterra Developments near 28 Avenue and 156 Street in Grandview Heights, South Surrey, and Hyde Park Corner is a separate, smaller townhome phase on the same street. Hyde Park has no board sub-area and no SnapStats row of its own.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Hyde Park

items.t: Plans: Surrey's current Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 21900, adopted June 15, 2026, which replaced Bylaw 18020. The North Grandview Heights Neighbourhood Concept Plan also covers the neighbourhoods north of 28 Avenue between King George Boulevard and Highway 15.
Zoning — Surrey: Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs this area.

Small-scale multi-unit housing in Surrey: up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², up to 4 on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, under the zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. Whether a lot qualifies depends on the lot. These rules don't apply to the Hyde Park townhomes themselves, which are set by their strata plans.

Strata rules that apply to both complexes (and to any bare-land strata lot): the Form B must be provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page. Since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, and since November 1, 2023 they must put at least 10% of the operating budget into the contingency reserve. Bylaws that restrict rentals have been void since November 24, 2022. The only valid age bylaw is 55 and older (with exemptions from May 1, 2023), so a "45+" line in a listing isn't an enforceable age limit in BC.

blocks.text: Good to know about Hyde Park

items.t: Grandview's attached pool is the second-largest in the community (Sep 2026). Grandview's 146 Condos & Townhomes listings sit behind only White Rock's 193 in S Surrey White Rock — Hyde Park resales are a single-complex subset of that pool, not a board category. (SnapStats, September 2026)

Surrey taxes carry two penalty dates, not one. Due July 2, 5% if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% after September 2 — a late lot or home purchase closing around those dates needs the tax position checked on the City account.

faq.a: No — Hyde Park is a named townhome complex in Grandview Surrey, near 28 Avenue and 156 Street. A Zenterra brochure lists it at 156 townhomes in the developer's project history, and there is no Hyde Park board sub-area or SnapStats row.
faq.q: Is Hyde Park a neighbourhood in South Surrey?

faq.a: The real estate board doesn't publish figures for Hyde Park on its own. The closest numbers are for the Grandview sub-area: in September 2026, 66 detached homes were listed and 9 sold (14%), and 146 condos and townhomes were listed and 20 sold (14%). Across South Surrey and White Rock, the median attached home sold for $700,000, at 99% of list price, after 33 days on the market. These are area figures, not Hyde Park prices, and the board doesn't publish sub-area medians.
